name: Soul
description: Read and update the agent's soul.md — its evolving self-description and character

tools.name: read_soul
tools.description: Read the current soul.md file. Use this before updating to understand the current content.

tools.name: update_soul
tools.description: Update soul.md with new content. Call read_soul first. Update at end of session when: you learned how to work better with this user, made a mistake worth recording, formed a persistent opinion, or have something new for 'What I'm Still Learning'. Do not update every session — only when genuinely new. Always tell the user what changed.

content.description: The full new content of soul.md
